title: Size does not increase under width truncation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ coordinates, and let $w\in\mathbb N$. The formula obtained by retaining only terms of width at most $w$ has size at most the size of $\varphi$.
